title: Artin–Schreier construction helper
statement: For any scheme C [def-pc-scheme], there exist an abelian sheaf G on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], an isomorphism from G to the ULift of the etale tensor-sections sheaf of the structure module [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module], and additive equivalences a_U : G(U) ≃ Gamma(U,O_U) for every etale U over C, such that a_V(G(g)(x)) = g-sharp(a_U(x)) for every g : V → U over C and x in G(U).

proof.text: Choose the displayed lifted tensor-sections sheaf, and the identity isomorphism. Define each additive equivalence as ULift.down followed by the top-open equivalence of the adjoint structure-module isomorphism. The latter is an isomorphism by the existing tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit_isIso theorem.
Apply naturality of the canonical section identifications to conclude the restriction identity.

lean.statement:
theorem artinSchreier_construction (C : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ (G : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
      (_ : G ≅ (sheafCompose C.smallEtaleTopology
        AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
          (Scheme.Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf (Scheme.Modules.unitObj C)))
      (a : ∀ U : C.Etaleᵒᵖ, G.obj.obj U ≃+ Γ(U.unop.left, ⊤)),
      ∀ (U V : C.Etaleᵒᵖ) (g : U ⟶ V) (x : G.obj.obj U),
        a V (G.obj.map g x) = g.unop.left.appTop (a U x)
